reason: My cousin back home handles these things for me and I usually sort the rest when I am in India, so I would not switch to a stranger's service just because it looks tidy. Nothing is urgent, and I only travel there every couple of years anyway.
objection: I do not know this company, and moving lakhs of rupees is not something I hand to a website when someone in the family already does it. The fee looks fair, but my cousin charges me nothing.
would_change_my_mind: My cousin or a friend I trust had used it and told me it went smoothly, or my cousin became unable to help and I needed the money out before my next trip.
